summary: mtaḥqabwayno has first-person -no and belongs in Infectum-wa.
rationale: The Preterit base is mtaḥqable with an l-agent ending; -wa plus first-person -no in the personal-communication form supports Infectum-wa. Retain the form and its missing translation.

summary: New sense 1b: nach j-m forschen, j-n ausfindig zu machen suchen (mit ʕal-);

data.label: 1b
data.gloss: nach j-m forschen, j-n ausfindig zu machen suchen (mit ʕal-);

rationale: 101/14 directs the activity at an absent man and continues with attempts to make him appear in Mardin. This investigative search differs from tracking an already observed traveler. One attestation; no causative stem is implied by the German.

data.turoyo: Qayəm gəmtaḥqəb u ḥakəm ʕal u zlamano, ksoyəm w lo ksoyəm, d nofəq bi walaye d Murde, lə gnofəq.
data.translation: Der Wali ließ Nachforschungen nach dem Mann anstellen; aber was er auch tat und nicht tat, damit er in Mardin zum Verschein käme, er kam nicht zum Vorschein.

rationale: Only attestation of the new investigative subsense; retain its full appearance/search context.

data.turoyo: Hən ḥəzyalle, qm u Botaš ze bəṯran w hiya komtaḥqbo aʕli.
data.translation: einige L.cute haben das Auto auch beim Botas hinter uns geschen, es beobachtete mich.

rationale: Adds the later surveillance clause of the same verse, beyond the existing truncated LB 22 excerpt.

summary: All four occurrences were checked. The glossary labels this borrowed quadriliteral I; that label is retained. The m-prefix belongs to the base, not an extra stem assignment.

bəṯri marks following behind, while aʕli/ʕal u zlamano marks the tracking or investigative target. The investigation example has no overt caused investigator, despite German ließ Nachforschungen anstellen.
Talay 1/19 and the first Talay 1/22 token already supply LB 19 and LB 22. Only the later, fuller surveillance clause is added to the thin Infectum cell.

The reader mentions sym taḥqib in an unsupplied adjacent verse. The permitted taḥq lookup returned no corresponding idiom, and this supplied evidence does not contain the light-verb construction; no new idiom is reconstructed.
Confirm the investigative rather than mere pursuit reading of 101/14; the absent target and appearance clause support the proposed subsense.
Please confirm the refiled personal-communication mtaḥqabwayno form and supply its translation. Its -no favors Infectum-wa over the inherited Preterit-wa heading.
Can the team document sym taḥqib beside the integrated verb? The adjacent verse invoked by the reader was not opened in this job.
The taxi is a metonymic agent for the observers; this is no new vehicle-subject sense.
